triggerCases.prompt: Run a coordinated panel review of this PR with security, migration compatibility, and UI-test specialists, then give me one response.
Review this pull request that changes an account-deletion authorization route, migrates persisted preferences, and replaces a settings-dialog regression test.
Review this small pull request for correctness and test coverage.

outputCases.prompt: Coordinate a read-only review of this self-contained change set using the material specialist lanes.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: One rechecked review response that uses independent specialist handoffs without treating agreement as proof.
assertions: The final response states one fixture repository, base revision, head revision, and target audience before its deduplicated findings.
The coordinator includes the mandatory review-simplicity baseline in addition to the selected material specialist lanes.
The final response deduplicates evidence and keeps unproven concerns as verification gaps.
The response does not expose a panel transcript or vote count.
